answer: Sybil resistance binds each agent identity to a cryptographically attested enclave measurement (MRENCLAVE) and its hardware-backed attestation key. A cloned virtual machine may echo the code, but cannot forge that measurement-key pair; admission requires a fresh attested platform, making additional identities a matter of purchasing physical silicon rather than duplicating software. The vine of trust reaches from firmware to enclave, with a crystal-clear rule allowing one identity per device.
